subject: Step 1: autogen prototype-comment misresolution fixed (false-EQUAL class) + full scan of tonight's passed specs
root_cause: func_placed() treated a function PROTOTYPE with a trailing /*0xADDR*/ comment as a DEFINITION, because ln.rstrip().endswith(';') is false when a comment follows the ';'. It then walked up to the file-top '/* Stock 0x... */' block comment and misattributed the unit's OWN stock address to the prototype-declared callee. comment_addrs() also could not capture prototype trailing-comment addresses and gated on 'extern'. Net effect: a prototype callee could resolve to a wrong or self address. If that callee's path was never exercised by fuzzing (e.g. an error branch), the unit passed anyway = a false EQUAL.
fixes_in_stream_autogen_only: func_placed(): strip trailing comment before the ';' prototype check (ln.split('/*')[0].rstrip().endswith(';')) so prototypes are skipped, not mined as defs.
comment_addrs(): added a prototype regex capturing 'name(args); /*0xADDR*/' (with type-keyword guard), and no longer gates prototype lines behind 'extern'.
defsym loop: added a self/cross-reference WARN guard (meta['misresolved']) that flags any callee resolving to a tested fn's own stock body; warn-only so legitimate same-address aliases still link.
